text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mazeikiu Nafta signed an agreement with Klaipedos Nafta to transport diesel fuel via Klaipeda port instead of Venstpils from July 1. Mazeikiu Nafta took an obligation to export monthly 50,000 tonnes of diesel fuel via Klaipedos Nafta terminal.
- The Social Democrats said they fear that private hospitals will try to avoid providing emergency care after the health care law was passed on Tuesday.
